🎲 DISE Intrinsic-Dynamic: Rotation Reasoning

Can a VLM predict which face ends up on top after rotation? MuJoCo verifies.

Top = Face 1 (Red)
Bottom = Face 2 (Green)
Front = Face 3 (Blue)
Back = Face 4 (Yellow)
Right = Face 5 (Orange)
Left = Face 6 (Purple)

Task 1: Rotate 90° clockwise around Y-axis

✅ CORRECT
A cube with colored faces sits on a table. The faces are: Red (top), Green (bottom), Blue (front), Yellow (back), Orange (right), Purple (left). If the cube is rotated 90° clockwise around the Y-axis (when viewed from the positive Y direction), which face will be on top?
Ground Truth: right → 5 (Orange)
MuJoCo Result: right → 5 (Orange)
